# R14f generality cells (synthetic)

Generated by `generality_cell()` and `generality_post_de()` in `tests/fixtures/post_de/design_factory.py`
(seeded standard-library values; no study data). Every cell has 30 features with planted structure:
F01-F05 shift by +1 in the first non-reference group (in `continuous_exposure` they follow the exposure `dose`,
which is the primary contrast), F06-F10 follow the phenotype `score`, F11-F20 share one latent factor per subject.

| Cell | Units | Design |
|---|---|---|
| `two_group` | 12 + 12 | independent |
| `three_group` | 10 + 10 + 10 | independent, two contrasts |
| `paired` | 10 subjects x 2 groups | subject-blocked (duplicate correlation) |
| `repeated` | 12 subjects x 2 visits, group constant within subject | subject-blocked |
| `continuous_exposure` | 12 + 12 | primary contrast = centred `dose` slope; group contrast secondary |
| `small_3v3` | 3 + 3 | independent |
| `unbalanced_15v80` | 80 + 15 | independent |
| `large_200` | 100 + 100 | independent |
| `human`, `mouse`, `rat` | 12 + 12 | independent; identifiers in that species' synthetic style, with a synthetic mapping and PPI snapshot prepared by `resources prepare` |

Every module is declared identically on every cell. The expected state of each module x cell (COMPLETED or the
typed refusal) is written in `tests/integration/test_post_de_generality.py` before any run.
